Goal `core-time-duration-1-2`, 6 of its 10 members done: `Core\Time\Duration::compareTo`, `days`,
`hours`, `microseconds`, `milliseconds` and `minutes` each have `about.md`, three examples, an attack,
a bench and a Rust test carrying its `covers:` marker. The three small units share one Rust test,
`duration_microseconds_milliseconds_and_minutes_are_exact_and_bounded_on_both_sides` in
`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs`. `Core\Time\Duration` has its class card (`DURATION_CARD`), so the
`help` proof is paid for every member. No proof found a bug. Nothing is blocked.

items.text: **`Core\Time\Duration::nanoseconds`** — owes examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). Every `int` fits, so its attack is the ends of `int` and a sum past them. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:789`
**`Core\Time\Duration::negated`** — owes examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). The duration of `i64::MIN` nanoseconds has no negation. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:945`
**`Core\Time\Duration::multipliedBy`** — owes examples, hostile, perf and one more test (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:929`
